title: cathartolinum rupestre
intro: Cathartolinum rupestre, commonly known as the rock cathartic, is a plant species that belongs to the family of plants with medicinal properties. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the ability to stimulate digestion, relieve constipation, and promote the expulsion of intestinal parasites. The therapeutic actions of Cathartolinum rupestre include its cathartic, emetic, and purgative properties, which can be beneficial for treating various gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
